headline: Fisherman's Row Rekindles While Farranac Coast Stays Hottest
war_summary: Farranac Coast holds its place as the liveliest sheet in the war, three base actions within the last two hours and twelve across the day, Scythe and Terra the most-worked grounds, the freshest entry in the field logged this evening. Fisherman's Row has rekindled since our last edition, four actions inside two hours about Fort Ember and Hangman's Court, its casualty returns climbing at an accelerating rate. Tempest Island, busiest in the previous dispatch, has fallen silent these two hours, though fifteen actions stand in its day's account; Lykos Isle likewise slackens to three in six, Fort Guile and The Squall still its most-contested works. Godcrofts keeps up a desultory exchange at Lipsia, and Stlican Shelf shows fresh movement at Fort Hoarfrost. The Dead Lands have filed no base movement since early afternoon, yet their ledger of some thirteen thousand Colonial and fifteen thousand Warden losses in a day remains second only to the Weathered Expanse, which stands silent in works but grimmest of all. This is the hundred-and-first day of a war still without a verdict, thirty-four victory towns the prize.
